clue.text: Remote location in loop, might you say?

definitions.meaning: an isolated, sleepy place cut off from the main current of events
read the word loop from right to left and you get pool, a body of water, so the water there is going the other way

explanation.surface: Someone describing a far-off spot as being stuck in a loop, cut off from things.
explanation.walkthrough: Paul's second half is playful: spell LOOP the other way round and it says POOL, so the water in it is 'back'. The two words of the answer are describing what happens to the clue word.
explanation.definitionFit: An isolated place untouched by progress is a figurative stagnant stretch of river, so the idiom means a remote spot.

clue.text: One's left foot in bathtub, ask to remove right

indicators.note: the foot of a word in a down clue is its bottom, final letter
to remove signals that a letter is taken away from the word before it

parts.note: to ask is to make a request

explanation.surface: Someone's left foot is in the bath, and they are asking to take it out on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's left' reads as a person's left side but means something one leaves behind in a will. Taking R from REQUEST leaves EQUEST.
explanation.definitionFit: A legacy is property a person has left to someone in their will, so 'one's left' describes it.

clue.text: Read aloud Prague's hotel register?

indicators.note: reading aloud means the letters entered match the sound of the words spoken

parts.note: Prague is the Czech capital, and an inn is a hotel, so a Czech inn

explanation.surface: A request to read out the guest register of a hotel in Prague.
explanation.definitionFit: To register on arrival at a hotel or airport is the standard sense of the phrasal verb.

clue.text: Cold in head spreading in January, perhaps — something needed to keep warm?

indicators.note: the whole assembly goes in, inside, the month's season

parts.note: January is an example of a month in winter

indicators.note: Cold goes in, inside, the rearranged letters of head
spreading means the letters of head are spread out into a new order

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Having a head cold in January calls for something warm to wear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spreading' scrambles the head to DHEA; the first 'in' puts C in that, the second sets the lot inside the season. The surface's 'head cold' splits into two separate jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: A windproof jacket is an outer garment worn to stay warm, matching the questioning definition.

clue.text: Moisture beneath one in river channel

indicators.note: in places the letters before it inside the river's name

parts.note: the Tay is the longest river in Scotland

indicators.note: in a down clue beneath means the moisture comes below, after, the one

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
dew is moisture condensed on surfaces overnight

explanation.surface: Dampness lying beneath a person in a river channel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'river' wants to be part of the definition with 'channel', but it is the Tay, the Scottish river.
explanation.definitionFit: A tideway is the channel or stretch of river along which the tide flows.

clue.text: Rash came up on legs and heads

parts.note: came up means rose, as the sun does

indicators.note: heads means the first letters of each of the words on, legs and and are taken

explanation.surface: A rash appeared on someone's legs and head.
explanation.definitionFit: Roseola is a medical condition producing a rosy skin eruption, especially in infants.

clue.text: See 19
Novel abandoned, unfinished

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter is removed from the word; the run of letters inside this word itself is a coincidence

parts.note: to shed something is to abandon or cast it off

explanation.surface: A novel that was given up on before being completed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like an adjective meaning new but names H. Rider Haggard's 1887 adventure novel.
explanation.definitionFit: H. Rider Haggard's adventure book about Ayesha is an example of a novel.

clue.text: American English lacking in proposal, zilch in shorthand?

indicators.note: lacking in means the proposal is missing the letter for English

parts.note: an idea is a proposal or suggestion

indicators.note: in puts zilch inside the short hand

parts.note: read as short hand: hand shortened by its last letter
zilch is nothing, the letter O

explanation.surface: An American English speaker's proposal comes to nothing in shorthand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shorthand' looks like stenography but splits as 'short hand', HAND lacking its D.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the US state Boise is capital of is an example of an American.

clue.text: Wrong coming up with blue for red

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means the word reads from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
the sky is blue

explanation.surface: A mistake in swapping one colour for another, blue for red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'red' reads as a colour but means a communist, here Leon Trotsky.
explanation.definitionFit: Leon Trotsky was a Russian revolutionary, and red is a common label for a communist.

clue.text: Piece, central to, or on the far side of, banner

definitions.meaning: a chess piece, the most powerful one on the board

definitions.text: central to, or on the far side of, banner
definitions.meaning: the middle of the word banner is Anne, a monarch, and its end is R, the abbreviation for Regina, also a monarch

explanation.surface: Something central to a banner, or seen on the far side of it.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half is a playful definition: BANNER has ANNE in its centre and R (Regina) at its far end, each a female monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: The strongest chess piece is named for a female monarch, and both Anne and Regina are such rulers.

clue.text: Time of special power, perhaps, in recollection of deviant criminal

indicators.note: in places the time of special power inside the turned-round word
recollection, read as re-collection, has the word odd collected backwards

parts.note: odd means deviant, out of the ordinary
ESP, extrasensory perception, is an example of a special power
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A deviant criminal remembering a time when he had special powers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recollection of' reverses ODD to DDO, which holds ESPERA.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless outlaw, especially of the Wild West, is a kind of criminal.

clue.text: Time has no beginning — whoops!

indicators.note: has no beginning means the first letter of the time word is removed

parts.note: a week is a period of time

explanation.surface: A cry of alarm at realising time has no start.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are exclamations of fright or dismay, so they are interchangeable interjections.

clue.text: Pair seen in Texas, perhaps — unqualified drug dealers?

parts.note: a cowboy is British slang for an unqualified, dodgy tradesman
Boots is a large British chain of chemists, which deal in drugs

explanation.surface: Unqualified drug dealers working in Texas, perhaps as a pair.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage a cowboy is a rogue tradesman, and Boots is a British high-street pharmacy chain.
explanation.definitionFit: Western-style footwear comes in pairs and is commonly worn in Texas, an example given by the clue.

clue.text: Place throw vertically over fitting, very straight

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first part sits above the second
vertically in a down clue means the words are read upwards

parts.note: to put is to place
to lob is to throw high
right means fitting or proper

explanation.surface: Instructions for putting a throw vertically over a fitting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vertically' turns PUTLOB upwards to give BOLTUP.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting rigidly erect with a perfectly straight back is what the idiom describes.

clue.text: Aim to impress girl in skin-treatment establishment

indicators.note: to impress is to press into, so the girl is pressed into the aim

parts.note: to try is to aim or attempt
Anne is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Aiming to impress a girl at a beauty or skincare salon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skin-treatment establishment' suggests a spa, but it is where animal hides are made into leather.
explanation.definitionFit: A works where hides are cured into leather treats skins, so it is such an establishment.

clue.text: To spare a net breaking, fold round it

indicators.note: round it means the fold surrounds the broken net

parts.note: a ply is a fold or layer

indicators.note: breaking signals the letters of net are broken up

explanation.surface: Folding something round a net so it is spared from breaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' gives ENT, and 'it' refers back to that broken net, so the fold wraps only those three letters, with A standing in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Having something in abundance means there is more than enough, some to spare.

clue.text: Fur tops taken off, freeze

indicators.note: taken off as in a garment removed and messed up, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Taking off your fur hat when it is freezing.
explanation.definitionFit: To become covered with ice crystals is to freeze over, which the phrasal verb describes.

clue.text: Expect number and letter on the phone?

indicators.note: on the phone, heard down the line, means the letters match a sound

parts.note: the number four and the letter C, spoken as see

explanation.surface: Expecting a number and a letter to be read out over the phone.
explanation.definitionFit: To anticipate or predict something is to expect it in advance.

clue.text: Do away with cracks above it

indicators.note: cracks means the words are broken open and their letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Getting rid of the cracks above something.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove the need for something or prevent it is to do away with it.

clue.text: Excellent injecting iodine in the months of pregnancy?

indicators.note: injecting means the iodine is put inside the other word

parts.note: playfully, the months before becoming a mum are pre-mum
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: An excellent treatment injecting iodine during pregnancy.
explanation.walkthrough: Paul invents PREMUM, the time before becoming a mum, flagged by the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means of top quality, superior, so excellent.

clue.text: Pompous type, why the overweight appearance?

definitions.meaning: a top that has been crammed full would make the wearer look fat

explanation.surface: Asking a pompous type why they look so fat.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a stuffy, conventional, self-important person, a pompous type.

clue.text: Hat collections being worn, including first of trilbies

indicators.note: including means the sets take in the first letter of trilbies

parts.note: sets are collections

indicators.note: first of means only the first letter of trilbies is used

parts.note: on means being worn, as clothes are

explanation.surface: Collections of hats being worn, including some trilbies.
explanation.definitionFit: A broad-brimmed cowboy hat is an example of a hat.

clue.text: Time of life devoted to bonding?

parts.note: to be for something is to be devoted to it
ties are bonds

explanation.surface: A time of life given over to forming bonds with others.
explanation.definitionFit: The decade of age from forty to forty-nine is a period of a person's life.

clue.text: Loading heavy weight up, something to sign, marked

indicators.note: loading means the sign document has the reversed weight loaded inside it

parts.note: a deed is a legal document that is signed

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read upwards

parts.note: a ton is a heavy weight

explanation.surface: Loading a heavy weight before signing for it and marking the delivery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the weight upwards, giving NOT, and 'Loading' puts that inside the document.
explanation.definitionFit: To denote is to indicate or signify, so denoted means marked or indicated.

clue.text: Is one's engagement a head-turner?

parts.note: when a driver engages the gear for going backwards they turn their head to look behind

explanation.surface: Asking whether someone's betrothal is turning heads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engagement' suggests marriage plans and 'head-turner' a stunning person, but a driver engaging this gear turns to look over their shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting a car into the backward-driving gear makes the driver turn their head round.

clue.text: Be in charge of career

definitions.meaning: to manage or direct something, as a business
to career is to rush along at speed

explanation.surface: Being in charge of one's own career.
explanation.definitionFit: Managing a firm is running it, and to career headlong is to dash or sprint.

clue.text: Canvas items. I say, with salts at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are in disarray

explanation.surface: A sailor exclaiming about canvas sails and old salts at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'salts' are old sailors in the surface, but only their letters are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Triangular fore-and-aft sails are pieces of canvas set on a ship's stays.

clue.text: Appearing in dungarees, Italian model

indicators.note: appearing in means the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An Italian model appearing in a pair of dungarees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' looks like a noun but is the verb: to pose for an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: To pose for a portrait or photograph is to model as a subject.

clue.text: Shame only valuable on the surface, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear means the words give a sound, not a spelling

parts.note: gilt is a thin gold coating, so precious only on the outside

explanation.surface: Shame at something that only looks valuable on the outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeling of remorse for wrongdoing is close to shame.

clue.text: Turn out, on being missed by team

indicators.note: being missed by means on is removed from the team name

parts.note: Everton is an English Premier League football club from Liverpool

explanation.surface: A player who turns out but is missed by the team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn out' reads as appearing for a team but means turn inside out.
explanation.definitionFit: To evert is to turn an organ or part inside out, so to turn it out.

clue.text: After conversion, 1 x 500 turned into currency

indicators.note: after conversion means the spelt-out letters are converted into a new order

parts.note: one written as a word
x is the multiplication sign, read as times
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: A conversion sum, one times five hundred, turned into currency.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's arithmetic is a decoy: nothing is calculated; the figures and sign are written out in words and Roman numerals before rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: To monetise is to convert something into money or make it legal tender.
